SELECT NOTICE_NO, NOTICE_TITLE, NOTICE_CONTENT, NOTICE_CATEGORY, USER_NO, USER_NAME, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, EVENT_START, EVENT_END, VIEW_COUNT FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM RNUM, A.* FROM ( SELECT n.NOTICE_NO, n.NOTICE_TITLE, n.NOTICE_CONTENT, n.NOTICE_CATEGORY, n.USER_NO, u.USER_NAME, n.CREATED_AT, n.UPDATED_AT, n.EVENT_START, n.EVENT_END, n.VIEW_COUNT FROM NOTICE_TBL n LEFT JOIN USER_TBL u ON n.USER_NO = u.USER_NO
n.NOTICE_CATEGORY = #{category}
AND
n.NOTICE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
n.NOTICE_CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
(n.NOTICE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR n.NOTICE_CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%')
ORDER BY n.CREATED_AT DESC ) A ) WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow}
mapper.update: UPDATE NOTICE_TBL SET NOTICE_TITLE = #{noticeTitle}, NOTICE_CONTENT = #{noticeContent}, NOTICE_CATEGORY = NVL(#{noticeCategory}, '공지'), EVENT_START = #{eventStart, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EVENT_END = #{eventEnd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE NOTICE_NO = #{noticeNo}
UPDATE NOTICE_TBL SET VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT + 1 WHERE NOTICE_NO = #{noticeNo}
mapper.select: SELECT n.NOTICE_NO, n.NOTICE_TITLE, n.NOTICE_CONTENT, n.NOTICE_CATEGORY, n.USER_NO, u.USER_NAME, n.CREATED_AT, n.UPDATED_AT, n.EVENT_START, n.EVENT_END, n.VIEW_COUNT FROM NOTICE_TBL n LEFT JOIN USER_TBL u ON n.USER_NO = u.USER_NO WHERE n.NOTICE_NO = #{noticeNo}
SELECT IMG_NO, IMG_PATH, IMG_RENAME, IMG_ORIGINAL_NAME, IMG_MAIN_YN, NOTICE_NO FROM NOTICE_IMG_TBL WHERE NOTICE_NO = #{noticeNo} ORDER BY IMG_NO ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO NOTICE_IMG_TBL ( IMG_NO, IMG_PATH, IMG_RENAME, IMG_ORIGINAL_NAME, IMG_MAIN_YN, NOTICE_NO ) VALUES ( SEQ_NOTICE_IMG_NO.NEXTVAL, #{imgPath}, #{imgRename}, #{imgOriginalName}, NVL(#{imgMainYn}, 'N'), #{noticeNo} )
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY\"-\"MM\"-\"IW') AS LABEL, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM NOTICE_TBL GROUP BY TO_CHAR(CREATED_AT, 'YYYY\"-\"MM\"-\"IW') ORDER BY LABEL
